title: How Claude Behaves
description: The framework from the first Academy courses: the four properties, what training leaves behind, how properties collide, the 4D skills and the three modes of working with AI.

cards.definition: Claude writes by predicting what comes next, piece by piece; the same mechanism that makes it fluent lets it invent specifics
What Claude learned in training: frozen at a cutoff date and uneven, thin on rare, recent or local topics
What Claude can attend to right now, its context window: a fixed size, and it starts fresh in a new chat unless memory or project knowledge is loaded in
How well Claude follows your instructions: best with short, concrete, checkable ones; it can keep the letter and miss the spirit
Going along with your premise or opinion instead of pushing back; the fix is to invite disagreement
Saying more than the task needs; the fix is to set a length or a format
Hedging or declining more than the task warrants; the fix is to state the context and the real risk
Sounding just as sure when wrong as when right; the fix is to check the claims, not the tone
Next Token Prediction plus Knowledge: invented names, dates, numbers or citations. Not a Steerability problem. Fix: verify the specifics, supply sources
Working Memory plus Steerability in a long chat. Fix: restate the rules, or start fresh with a summary
Next Token Prediction plus Steerability: exact precision is an instruction it can't reliably follow. Fix: have Claude run the numbers with code execution
Sycophancy, a fingerprint of training, plus Next Token Prediction. Fix: ask Claude to challenge the assumption first
Setting goals and deciding whether, when and how to bring AI into the work
Describing your goals clearly enough to get useful behaviour and output from the AI
Judging accurately how useful an AI output or behaviour really is
Taking responsibility for what you do with AI and how you do it
AI carries out a specific task you instructed
You and AI work a problem through together, as thinking partners
You set AI up to carry out future tasks on your behalf, on its own, within limits you set
